title: singular Read-only Working-tree Guard Result
description: What the read-only guard found and what it did about it. Written to result.json in the journal directory after every restore, including the ones that had nothing to do.

journal.description: Directory holding the pre-run journal, the content blobs and the quarantine.

outcome.description: clean: the run left nothing behind. restored: the guard put something back — a containment failure that was repaired. reported: report mode found work it did not do. degraded: the guard could not act on a complete picture, so the run was effectively unguarded. no-journal: nothing to restore, usually because a prior restore already consumed it.

quarantine.description: Where bytes removed or overwritten by the restore were copied first. The guard never destroys content: when it cannot tell whether the agent or a concurrent writer produced a file, the answer is a move, not a loss.
